text:
marco: FYI — TuringSupply just updated lead times for the H100 wave. ETA moved from 2025-03-28 to 2025-04-12. this impacts our Dedicated Q2 commit.

katie: ugh. how many units affected?

marco: vendor manifest says 50 units total. 10 can ship this week, 40 are delayed pending customs clearance in FRA.

dmitri (TuringSupply): sorry for the hit — customs got held for HS-code reclassification. we can split shipments: 10 air now, 20 sea+air mix mid-apr, 10 held as backup. pricing for split: air surcharge +$750/unit on the 10.

benji: is that air surcharge per unit after our committed price? will this blow the margin for Dedicated customers?

dmitri (TuringSupply): surcharge is on top of committed unit price. we can absorb part if you want, but margin hit ~6-8% if we keep commit.

smythe: we need to consider provisioning impact — if only 10 show up, can we reallocate from non-prod pools? ops team to confirm.

marco: ops says we have ~8 spare h100s in eu-nonprod. can we top-up to meet 2 critical canaries?

benji: yes for canaries, but not for burst capacity. customers on reserved plans expect the commit. recommend we negotiate vendor credit for delay days.

katie: also RMA question — vendor flagged 3 DOA units within the 10 that can ship now. do we want them shipped as replacements or staged in depot for QA first?

marco: prefer depot QA. last time we got DOA straight to customer and had firmware mismatch pain.

ops-bot: Created RMA ticket RMA-4829, assigned to smythe.

smythe: acknowledged. i'll triage depot acceptance and firmware reconciliation. need AWBs and serials to pre-load our kitting checklist.

marco: vendor provided provisional AWBs / serial list:
```
AWB: AWB12345678 (10 units)
AWB: AWB23456789 (20 units)
Serials: SNL-HT100-0001 .. SNL-HT100-0050
```

dmitri (TuringSupply): confirming serials — 0007, 0012, 0020 flagged DOA in vendor QC. we'll mark those in manifest and include return labels.

benji: for customs delay — can vendor provide HS-code docs and invoice amendment? procurement needs those to contest hold and reduce duty reclassification risk.

dmitri (TuringSupply): yes, attaching docs to the portal now. ETA for customs release estimate 4-8 business days.

katie: if customs drags past 4/12 we need fallback: option A) accept air expedite for remaining 40 at extra cost B) offer prorated vendor credit + allow us to re-schedule bulk to next quarter.

marco: open action items: 1) dmitri to confirm final AWBs + return labels (by 1777770300). 2) smythe to confirm depot QA window and accept partial DOA (by 1777770400). 3) ops to inventory eu-nonprod spares and confirm if 8 units available for canaries (by 1777770200).

ops-bot: Reminder — vendor SLA clause 3.2 applies after 7 days of delay — procurement will open credit request automatically.

dmitri (TuringSupply): noted. i'll update AWBs by the deadline and escalate customs docs.

marco: thanks — we'll reconvene if customs estimate shifts. please ping this thread when AWBs finalized. :thumbsup:
